description: The Grimdark Laws of Materialization for Hive Tartarus. In the 41st Millennium, no fortification holds, no weapon fires, and no soul survives without irreversible expenditure.

materialization_laws.blood_tithe_principle: Human flesh is the most expendable yet essential resource in the Imperium. Manual labor without machinery demands biological casualties.
materialization_laws.machine_cant_principle: Ancient machinery will not function without the rituals of maintenance, sacred unguents, and Tech-Priest appeasement.
materialization_laws.sanctified_choke_point: Defensive positions held against the warp or xenos require consecrated holy relics or purity seals, else despair and psychic taint will rout the defenders.
materialization_laws.law_of_retaliation: No apex threat in the 41st Millennium falls passively. Every combat round triggers hostile counter-attacks, inflicting direct kinetic/acid damage against combatants and dealing attrition casualties.
materialization_laws.law_of_armor_penetration: Apex xenos and mutant carapaces possess heavy damage reduction (65%-80%) against standard lasguns and shotgun buckshot. Breaching requires dedicated armor-cracking assets (Krak charges, Power Fists, Autocannons, or Promethium immersion).
materialization_laws.law_of_mortal_peril: Characters whose Physical Vitality drops below 25 suffer critical injury debuffs. Reaching 0 Vitality results in traumatic limb severance or permanent death.

action_boss_carapace_breach.name: Heavy Ordnance Strike on Apex Carapace

required_resources.heavy_support: Power Fist grapple or heavy overwatch distraction mandatory

action_boss_carapace_breach.consequence_on_completion: Carapace cracked; exposes vital nerve clusters and strips 40% damage reduction.

action_boss_sustained_pinning.name: Concentrated Autocannon & Heavy Stubber Suppression

risks.conscript_casualty_risk: 1-3 troopers struck by ranged acid return

action_boss_sustained_pinning.consequence_on_completion: Suppresses apex mobility by 75%; interrupts lethal charge attacks.

action_reinforce_bulkhead.name: Weld Plasteel Bracing to Sump Bulkhead

psychological_cost.dissonance_risk: Fear of mutant breach during dark hours

action_reinforce_bulkhead.consequence_on_completion: Bulkhead blast threshold increased by 500%; prevents sudden underhive mutant breakthrough for 7 cycles.

action_consecrate_munitions.name: Ritual Consecration of Heavy Shells
action_consecrate_munitions.consequence_on_completion: Heavy macro-shells gain sanctified warhead blessing; eliminates misfire rate during bombardment.

action_scavenge_lower_sump.name: Expedition to Sump Charnel Ditch
action_scavenge_lower_sump.rewards: Salvaged cybernetic augmetics, unspent heavy stubber ammo, filtered water valves.
